scope: Osborn LUPC incorporation of FEMA case 22-01-0871P; publication review, not a parcel-specific legal determination

observations: The signed ZP 796 decision dated July 17, 2024 approves clerical map-note corrections effective August 1, 2024. Finding 5 states existing zoning remains unchanged; Osborn is included in the FIS/FIRM community list in finding 13.

Findings 8-11 describe adoption by map note and distinguish FIRM-only communities from county FIS/FIRM communities. The county example cites the 2016 Hancock FIS. The approved action corrects note wording; it does not establish adoption of the specific May 2024 Osborn LOMR.
The captured map is byte-identical to the prior reviewed map. Its note references the July 20, 2016 Hancock FIS and accompanying FIRM; its August 1, 2024 amendment is labeled a clerical correction.

Section 4.08,B,2,b permits staff handling of routine proposals to adopt new or amended FEMA maps. Delegated authority is not evidence that staff adopted this particular LOMR; a missing Commission agenda item would not establish non-adoption.
Section 10.23,C,2 identifies FEMA SFHA Zones A, AE and VE and requires an adoption note on the official map. FEMA boundaries also apply where they differ from Commission-mapped P-FP boundaries.

Section 10.25,T,1,d expressly addresses a LOMA/LOMR determining that a specified structure or property is outside the SFHA. This removal provision is not evidence that every hazard-adding LOMR is automatically incorporated. Broader flood-prone-area provisions still require consideration.
The February 12, 2025 adopted basis statement describes updates to flood development standards and NFIP consistency. Its stated purpose is not a determination adopting Osborn case 22-01-0871P.
LUPC's explanatory page says incorporation by reference identifies title, version and publication date. It supplies process context, not an Osborn-specific interpretation of a later LOMR.
